onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/locomotion/properties/aerial_movement.schema.json, set am_c_jump_style to {{am_c_jump_style}}]
Set jump style to {{am_c_jump_style}} by adjusting JumpAbility.jumpImpulse: low_hop=~2.5, standard=5.0, high_leap=~10.0.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/locomotion/properties/aerial_movement.schema.json, set am_c_variable_height to {{am_c_variable_height}}]
Toggle variable jump height: on=JumpAbility.abortJump() cancels upward velocity on button release, off=disable abort logic.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/locomotion/properties/aerial_movement.schema.json, set am_t_jump_impulse to {{am_t_jump_impulse}}]
Set JumpAbility.jumpImpulse to {{am_t_jump_impulse}}. Determines maximum jump height.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/locomotion/properties/aerial_movement.schema.json, set am_t_coyote_time to {{am_t_coyote_time}}]
Set JumpAbility.coyoteTime to {{am_t_coyote_time}}ms. Window to jump after walking off a ledge.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/locomotion/properties/aerial_movement.schema.json, set am_t_jump_buffer to {{am_t_jump_buffer}}]
Set JumpAbility.jumpBufferTime to {{am_t_jump_buffer}}ms. Window to queue a jump before landing.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/locomotion/properties/aerial_movement.schema.json, set am_t_jump_cooldown to {{am_t_jump_cooldown}}]
Set JumpAbility.jumpCooldown to {{am_t_jump_cooldown}}ms. Minimum time between consecutive jumps.
